# Edge cases for the properties panel's rules: two fragments, net charges (paraquat's +2
# gives a whole number from the formula, so only the charge rule hides it), a halogen,
# sulfur, and no carbon at all (degree of unsaturation shows "—" for some of these).
sodium benzoate
tetramethylammonium
paraquat
bromobenzene
dimethyl sulfoxide
boric acid
# Ring cis/trans: RDKit's current stereo perception finds two undefined centres here; its
# legacy perception (RDKit.js's default) finds none. Proves the worker switches legacy off.
1,4-dimethylcyclohexane
